entities.name: Lenka Ptáčníková
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lenka Ptáčníková is a Czech-Icelandic chess player who holds the title of Woman Grandmaster. She won twice the Czech women's chess championship, in 1994 and 1996, and fourteen times, to date, the Icelandic women's chess championship over a span of 15 years.
